items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:29:1
items.html: The Hassadim are given to ZA etc., and the Gevurot are given to the Nukva: It has already been explained that the drop of the coupling that is drawn to ZA is the phase of new revealed NHY, and it is Hassadim and Gevurot that come out from the Yesod of Ima, which is cut off at the place of the Chazeh [chest] of ZA. For their own phase is Hassadim, and the part of Malchut in them is Gevurot. And this is what he says: “the Hassadim are given to ZA, and through them the building of his posterior is completed and finished in wholeness.” For now that he has attained NHY with illumination of Hochma, in the phase of the NHY of direct light, as above, all the Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] of his posterior has been completed, and there is no longer any deficiency in them. Therefore they can now be revealed outward without any fear of the externals, as above. “And the Gevurot are given to the Nukva, and through them her posterior is completed,” for the Gevurot, which are the phase of NHY with illumination of Hochma, included in the drop of the coupling of AVI from the side of the Gevurot in them, are bestowed upon the Nukva. And now the NHY of the Nukva, too, are completed and finished and are revealed outward without any fear of the shells. Therefore they are now separated from one another, for each one has a posterior of its own.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:29:2
items.html:
They can turn face to face since their posteriors are complete, etc., which is not so at first, when this one had half a posterior and that one half, and they were able to grip them: As written above, at the time they were back to back — which means that they were shielded by the posterior of Ima, which prefer the light of Hassadim and reject the light of Hochma. It is true that this was enough to guard them from the externals, so that they could not grip at the place of their deficiency, that is, the deficiency of illumination of Hochma. For while they are corrected in these posteriors they do not desire Hochma and have no need of it, and therefore no deficiency is apparent in them by which the externals could grip there. Even so, they are regarded as lacking NHY, as above, for the place of the deficiency of Hochma is apparent chiefly in their NHY. (A note in the author’s own handwriting: for what is lacking from the NHY of the vessels is lacking from the GAR [first three] of the lights, because of the inverse relation between vessels and lights; and so it may be said.) This is because, in relation to direct light, they are the very ZON of direct light, whose whole essence is nothing but the phase of illumination of Hochma within them: for the Bina of direct light is light of Hassadim without Hochma at all, since she desires nothing but Hassadim, in the secret of “for He delights in mercy.” Therefore the GAR in her are regarded as HGT, for KHB from the side of Hassadim are regarded as HGT, as is known.
Only at the time when she emanated ZON, since she saw that there is no existence for Hassadim without illumination of Hochma, and she went back and drew illumination of Hochma into the Hassadim — this drawing is regarded as having already departed from the phase of Bina of direct light and acquired a name of its own, which is ZON, or NHYM of direct light. (See above, Part 4, Chapter 6, in the Inner Light, item 80.) And you see that the whole difference between Bina and the NHY of direct light is only in the illumination of Hochma that she drew: the phase of Hassadim without illumination of Hochma is Bina’s own portion in her source, while the phase of illumination of Hochma in the Hassadim is the portion of the NHYM, or ZON. (See above, Part 1, page 5, the passage beginning “And the reason.”)
And now it has been well explained that the essence of the degree of NHY is nothing but the phase of illumination of Hochma within them. Therefore, as long as there is no illumination of Hochma in them, they are the bearers of this deficiency, and therefore the shells and the externals grip this deficiency. For this reason the NHY are called by the name posterior, for posterior means a place of deficiency. And this is what the ARI says above, in item 26, that the place of the shells and the externals is behind the Nukva of ZA and in the posterior of ZA, see there.
And because of the fear that the shells would grip these posteriors, which are the NHYM, they were corrected back to back, that is, in the posterior of Ima, as above, which are called a wall; and by means of this wall the NHYM were guarded so that the deficiency of Hochma would not appear in them, as above. This is the secret of “and their posteriors inward”: that the NHY are concealed in the internality, which is within the wall of Ima that shields them, while their faces are revealed outward — that is, their HGT, which have no need of illumination of Hochma from their source in direct light, as above, for they are drawn from the phase of Bina before she drew the light of Hochma. Therefore they can be revealed outward, for no deficiency is apparent in them and there is no place there for the externals to grip.
And this is what he says: “And then they can turn face to face, since their posteriors are complete and the externals now have no ability to grip there, which is not so at first, when this one had half a posterior and that one half, and they were able to grip them.” For at first, when both of them were corrected by a single wall, that is, by the posterior of Ima, both of them were cleaved to this wall, which is the wall of HGT, and there was no difference at all between ZA and the Nukva, for both of them are now the phase of Hassadim without Gevurot, since HGT are now entirely Hassadim, because of the posterior of Ima, which is the secret of “for He delights in mercy.” However, now that they have already attained the drop of the coupling of AVI, which is the NHY with illumination of Hochma, as above, their posteriors have now grown and been completed: ZA took the NHY from the side of the Hassadim, and his posteriors were completed and finished until there is no deficiency in him at all, for he already has illumination of Hochma in him. Therefore his posteriors, that is, the NHY, can be revealed outward without any fear. In the same way, the Nukva took these NHY from the side of the Gevurot, and her posterior was completed and finished, and she can now separate from the posterior of ZA, for she has a complete posterior of her own, that is, the Gevurot of the NHY. Therefore they now couple face to face and bestow illumination of Hochma upon their MAN [female waters], which are the souls of the righteous.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:29:3
items.html: For two reasons that are one, for they enlarge and complete the posterior of ZA, and further, that through this they turn face to face: For those complete posteriors that they attained, that is, the new revealed NHY, are what raise the HGT to the phase of HBD and to Mochin, and they then couple face to face. And since the Mochin and the coupling are drawn from those revealed NHY, they are therefore reckoned as one single phase.
